document_summary: Rashad studies Quran 9:52–72, beginning with trust that believers face only two good outcomes and giving Parivash a public apology for misunderstanding her statement. The passage becomes a detailed treatment of hypocrites who pray and give charity lazily, mock the messenger, create doubt inside the community, and conceal their inner condition. The group then distinguishes ordinary believers from those who strive. Lisa studies Quran 56:75–96 through cosmic scale, preservation of the Quran, sincere access to scripture, death, divine control, and the three final groups. Rashad closes with a large circular mathematical construction combining two long verse-number sequences attributed to Feroz Karmally and Abdullah.
